name: aml-automation
description: AML test automation — reads Excel/.docx test cases and generates Playwright scripts

scripts.pipeline:clean:keep-history: rimraf results/*/ && echo History preserved in results/allure-history/
scripts.pw:run:report: playwright test tests/e2e/ && tsx pipeline/src/excel-report.ts && tsx pipeline/src/allure-report.ts --no-open
scripts.milestone1:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/kycGapReportTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:kyc-gap-report:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/kycGapReportTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:customer-360-view:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/customer360ViewTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:ignore-words-configuration:ru: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/ConfigurationModule/ignoreWordsConfigurationTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:exception-list-manager:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/ConfigurationModule/exceptionListManagerTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:keyword-manager:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/ConfigurationModule/keywordManagerTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:missing-mandatory:run: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_HEADLESS=1 PW_WORKERS=6 PW_RETRIES=0 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/missingMandatoryTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:missing-mandatory:run:fast: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_HEADLESS=1 PW_WORKERS=8 PW_RETRIES=0 PW_SCREENSHOT=off PW_TRACE=off playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/missingMandatoryTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
scripts.milestone1:missing-mandatory:run:headed: cross-env PW_SKIP_ALLURE_REPORT=1 PW_SKIP_HTML_REPORT=1 PW_WORKERS=3 playwright test tests/milestone1/test-cases/KYCModule/missingMandatoryTests/ --project=milestone1-chromium
